question: Which of the following is a vulnerable species?
solution:
The answer is **Asiatic elephant**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**Vulnerable Species: 

 
• Species whose population has declined to levels from where it is likely to move into the endangered category in the near future if the negative factors continue to operate.
 
• Examples:
 
 
• Blue sheep, Asiatic elephant, Gangetic dolphi
